# judgespec.md

## Purpose

Evaluate a generated `spec.md` from a QA perspective.

## Evaluation Criteria

Score each category from 1-5.

  Category              Check
  --------------------- -----------------------------------
  Completeness          All requirements captured
  Correctness           Matches source requirements
  Clarity               Unambiguous language
  Testability           QA can derive test cases
  Business Rules        Explicitly documented
  Validation Rules      Positive/negative cases covered
  Edge Cases            Boundary/error scenarios included
  Acceptance Criteria   Clear and measurable
  Assumptions           Clearly separated
  Open Questions        Missing information identified

## Review Checklist

-   No implementation details.
-   No invented business logic.
-   Consistent terminology.
-   Markdown formatting is correct.
-   Tables are readable.
-   Suitable for manual and automation testing.

## Overall Verdict

-   PASS
-   PASS WITH COMMENTS
-   FAIL

## Improvement Recommendations

List all deficiencies with suggested corrections in priority order.
